title: Valid GitHub Actions context and bootstrap boundary for Hostinger Tenant Canary

phases.objective: Keep the canonical Tenant Canary workflow registrable, prevent workflow-only bootstrap self-triggering, and bind evidence publication to the current generic CI Evidence PR Publisher.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and trusted CI evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The canonical Tenant Canary workflow, bootstrap regression, routing registry, and generic CI evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub registers the read-only exact-head producer and the trusted generic publisher consumes the same run-bound secret-free artifact without invoking an unavailable runner context.
steps: Validate stable repository-relative report paths before runner execution.
Verify narrow triggers, exact-head checkout, canonical artifact production, routing, and trusted generic publication.
assertions: No jobs.<job_id>.env expression uses runner context before a runner exists.
The current generic CI Evidence PR Publisher is the only referenced trusted publisher.
No provider call, credential access, SQL, migration apply, deployment, Production mutation, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe the first qualifying exact-head Tenant Canary run and trusted publication through the canonical generic publisher.
Reject stale heads, unavailable contexts, missing artifacts, malformed reports, and publisher-route drift while remaining fail closed.
Record exact-head canonical Tenant Canary evidence through the trusted publisher.
This repository governance contract grants no provider, deployment, migration, SQL, or Production mutation authority.
